findings.title: Remove the second fixture mutation in Explore
findings.body: MockCommunityRepository already mutates SharedFixtureStore in toggleBookmark/toggleFollow. Under the UI-fixture launch flag, ExploreViewModel toggles that store a second time, undoing every mutation while displaying the first result. Reloading or opening Profile contradicts the visible action. Remove both view-model fixture toggles and let the repository own each mutation once.

findings.title: Scope fixture state to each instance and honor supplied seeds
findings.body: The process-wide SharedFixtureStore overrides explicit mock initialization and has no reset boundary. The existing bookmark test supplies savedRouteIDs=[] for Redpoint Ridge, but fetchExploreRoutes overwrites it from the singleton's initially saved Ridge; the follow test similarly starts against globally followed Maya. Tests/accounts can mutate one another, and public Set properties bypass synchronization. Inject an isolated synchronized store seeded from each fixture/test contract.

findings.title: Connect all fixture repositories to the same relationship state
findings.body: Original finding 27 remains beyond double toggling. MockFeedRepository still uses its private savedRouteIDs and embedded author.isFollowed; community/profile mutations use SharedFixtureStore, while profile/climber searches also read stale local follow state. Feed saves still do not update Saved Routes, and Explore follows do not update Following Feed/public profile. Make all projections consume the same scoped fixture state.

findings.title: Invalidate stale Explore pagination when filters change
findings.body: New loadMore does not capture/check generation, unlike load and HomeFeedViewModel pagination. A page for query/category A can finish after B loads and append A's routes to B while replacing B's continuation state. Capture the generation and cursor scope, discard stale responses, and reset pagination when starting a new search.

shared_contract: Platform iOS mechanics of frozen BOTH-platform V1 semantics. Preserve SessionPostCard onLike/onBookmark/onAuthorTap/onRouteTap ()->Void names and wire real callbacks everywhere; optional nil may replace default no-op if needed to render noninteractive when absent, coordinate exact type with journal owner. NativeFixtures owns SharedFixtureStore: remove process-wide shared; init(savedRouteIDs:Set<UUID>=[], followedClimberIDs:Set<UUID>=[]), synchronized private sets, isSaved(_:UUID)->Bool,isFollowing(_:UUID)->Bool,toggleSavedRoute(_:UUID)->Bool,toggleFollow(_:UUID)->Bool. All mock repository initializers gain fixtureStore:SharedFixtureStore?=nil; nil means new isolated store honoring existing supplied seeds. AppServices owns one explicit shared fixture instance supplied to feed/community/profile mocks. Journal owner implements MockProfileRepository constructor/projections against that same interface; no singleton anywhere. ProfileRepository.fetchSavedRoutes pagination may evolve with every current caller in journal-owned paths. Fixtures owner coordinates its tests against resulting signature, do not edit journal files. Journal private history reuses SessionRepository and SessionSyncService/SwiftData, no second persistence store; preserve account ownership and local pending edits. All workers skip all builds/tests/lint/formatters; Main verifies once immutable.
